description: A notch for Windows 11 showing how much of your Claude, ChatGPT and Gemini usage is left.
notes: Notchpoint runs from the tray. Start it from the Start menu shortcut, or run 'notchpoint'.
Settings live in %APPDATA%\Notchpoint and survive updates and uninstall.
To start it with Windows, open Settings from the tray icon and tick the box.
Scoop installs it portably, so there is no Apps & Features entry. Use 'scoop uninstall notchpoint'.
